data.name: Kishna
data.gender_notes: Kishna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Krishna, which means 'all-attractive'. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is a god known for his beauty, mischievousness, and love for butter and cows. Kishna is a name for those who embody these characteristics. The name Kishna carries the meaning “Little Krishna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kishna usually hope their child will grow to embody little krishna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine qualities of Krishna.
data.etymology: Kishna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Krishna.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kishna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kishna" carries a rich cultural significance, particularly in Hindu mythology. Krishna, the original bearer of the name, is the eighth avatar of the god Vishnu, revered in India and Nepal. He was renowned for his magnetic personality and was known as the 'God of Love' due to his capacity to attract everyone around him. The name 'Kishna' has become an integral part of Indian culture, representing the qualities of charm, love, and mischief.
data.spiritual_significance: Krishna is considered a divine figure in Hinduism with profound spiritual significance. He is believed to be the embodiment of divine love and the preserver of the universe. devotees often seek his guidance and blessings for a peaceful and loving existence. By accepting the name Kishna, an individual connects with the divine soul within themselves, inspiring them to radiate love, kindness, and attraction to all those around them. This spiritual connection imbues the individual with wisdom, courage, and a deep sense of honor.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Krishna is a divine name, symbolizing infinite love, joy, and mirth. It represents the playful and protective deity, who embodies the highest virtues of compassion, wisdom, and divine protection.
